name: The Tampa EDITION
insider_take: Tampa's first ultra-luxury lifestyle hotel brings Manhattan sophistication to Florida's Gulf Coast with a striking 39-story tower that redefines the city's skyline.
whats_special: The Tampa EDITION marks Ian Schrager's debut in Florida, featuring his signature minimalist design aesthetic. The hotel boasts the city's highest rooftop bar with panoramic views of Tampa Bay, while its location in the vibrant Channelside District puts you steps from the Florida Aquarium and Tampa Riverwalk. The property's sleek interiors showcase locally-sourced artwork and custom furnishings that blend urban edge with coastal elegance.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on floors 20+ for stunning sunset vistas over Tampa Bay, and time your rooftop visit during golden hour when the city lights begin to twinkle below.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant helmed by a James Beard-nominated chef, the infinity-edge pool deck with cabanas overlooking the water, and easy access to Tampa's burgeoning food scene in nearby Hyde Park and Ybor City. The Amalie Arena (home to the Lightning) and Tampa Theatre are just minutes away.
pros: Luxury EDITION brand experience with Ian Schrager design aesthetic
Prime downtown Tampa location with waterfront access
Marriott STARS Program benefits including room upgrades and resort credits
Contemporary rooftop dining and nightlife venues
cons: Urban location may have city noise
